releases.notes:
## Changelogs
- Added Button Blessing timer to the Micro Event Timer HUD
- Added shortcut chat commands for the backpack's other tabs: `/boots` and `/routes`
- Added AutoWelcome
- Made changes to the handshake method for connecting to DPTBot, preventing possible Mojang API ratelimits
- Fixed some raycast items' usage detection in Item Cooldown HUD
- Fixed Micro Event Timer HUD's text shadow and background configs not working properly
- Fixed the game crashing upon going back to the lobby after connecting to DPTBot


## Supported Minecraft versions:
- Forge: 1.8.9
- Fabric: 1.21.4, 1.21.11, 26.1.2

<sub>This will likely be the final pre-release before 1.2.3 is officially released, unless a major bug is found.</sub>

releases.notes:
- Implemented a new handshake method with the server to prevent scripting/impersonating other clients
- Implemented TLS over the WebSocket connection to the server to prevent spying
- Added Traffic light and Door timers to Micro Event Timer HUD
- Fixed Button Timer HUD and Last micro event in Micro Event Timer HUD

## Known issues:
- The Text Shadow and Render Background options for the Micro Event Timer HUD aren't working properly

Do note that this is a ***beta release***, meaning not every feature added/adjusted will guarantee to work properly. If you encounter any problem, please contact me on [Discord](https://discord.com/users/601604876648316938) or create an issue.

releases.notes: - Added the DPTBot Agree to Ramp setting. - If the option is disabled, the server will find a different client to delegate the ramp duty to even if your client is higher priority - Added the DPTBot Broadcast Sounds setting:. - If the option is disabled, no sound will be played when a broadcast is sent in chat or in notifications form - Removed the Speed 1 micro event and added the Slippery Ice micro event into the Micro Events Timer. - Some huge internal changes: - For the ramper, moved all the system messages to the server-side to handle over there. - Some initial implementations to avoid certain players being able to spoof their username in broadcasts. - Added support for Minecraft 1.21.11 - Removed support for Minecraft 1.21.7 & 1.21.10 ## You are required to install this update until 2026/03/23, otherwise your broadcasts will not be accepted to the ramp.
